# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.55

- **Hardware tutorial, as a picture book and two video clips**, from the works of Alexandru Dumbravă (A.I.D.M.I.A.): the phone digitisation table (diagram, parts and prices of April 2024, set-up, how to take the photos, common problems, copyright notes) and how LegatorOCR replaces his three-program chain. Eight languages: `docs/Tutorial-hardware-LegatorOCR*.pdf` (also in the release assets), clips `docs/video/hardware/*.mp4` with subtitles in eight languages (soft subtitles in the mp4 and `.vtt` files). Built by `docs/guide-src/hardware/make.py` and `scripts/make-hardware-videos.py`.
- Only the author's own diagram and photos are used; pictures he took from other sources are left out. The licence table notes that his written permission is still to be recorded.
- Contains pre.54 (winget "already installed" fix, 180° button, upside-down page detection, page thumbnails).

Known: the clips are slide-like animations over his pictures (no narration); the photos are small and are enlarged in the clips.
